rust.source: pub const LIMIT: u64 = 18446744073709551615; pub fn compare(input: i32) -> bool { input < 10 }
pub fn binding(input: i32) -> i32 { let mut value = input; { let input = value + 1; value = input; } value }
pub fn branch(condition: bool) -> i32 { let value: i32; if condition { value = 1; } else { value = 2; } value }
pub fn reference(input: &mut i32) -> i32 { let alias = &mut *input; *alias += 1; *input }
pub fn bad() -> i32 { let value = 1; value = 2; value }
pub fn bad() -> i32 { let value: i32 = "text"; value }
pub fn bad() -> i32 { { let inner = 1; } inner }
pub struct Boxed<T> { pub value: T } pub fn read<T>(input: Boxed<T>) -> T { input.value }
pub fn accumulate(input: i32) -> i32 { let mut total = 0; for value in 0..input { let mut add = |item| total += item; add(value); } total }
macro_rules! twice { ($value:expr) => { $value + $value }; } pub fn apply(input: i32) -> i32 { twice!(input) }

extends RefCounted
const LIMIT: int = 9223372036854775807
func compare(input: int) -> bool:
	return input < 10

extends RefCounted
func binding(input: int) -> int:
	var value: int = input
	value += 1
	return value

extends RefCounted
func container(input: int) -> int:
	var values: Array[int] = [input, 2]
	return values[0]

extends RefCounted
func bad() -> int:
	const value: int = 1
	value = 2
	return value

extends RefCounted
func bad() -> int:
	var value: int = "text"
	return value

extends RefCounted
func accumulate(input: int) -> int:
	var total: int = 0
	for value in range(input):
		var add = func(item: int) -> int: return item + 1
		total += add.call(value)
	return total

extends RefCounted
enum Mode { ON, OFF }
func select(mode: Mode) -> int:
	match mode:
		Mode.ON:
			return 1
		_:
			return 0
